The '''''Warhawk''''' was a [[Raider-class corvette/Legends|''Raider''-class corvette]] that served alongside the ''[[Sargantuan/Legends|Sargantuan]]'' and the ''[[Blood Ambition/Legends|Blood Ambition]]'' in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Navy]].<ref name="Friends" />
